Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning closing and elimination the opportunity gap.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to efforts to close and eliminate the opportunitygap; adding a new section to chapter 41.59 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 41.56 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the opportunitygap is demonstrated by the difference between the highest performingsubgroups of students and all other subgroups of students. Thelegislature recognizes that there is strong research that shows thatthe opportunity gap can lead to higher dropout rates, negative impactson the economy, and elevates stress in the community in the areas ofcrime, violence, and poverty. The legislature intends to sharpen thefocus of school districts on the opportunity gap by requiring eachcollective bargaining agreement to address actions to be taken to closeand eliminate the opportunity gap.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.59 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each collective bargaining agreement entered, reopened, and renewed p. 1 SB 6063after the effective date of this section must specifically addressactions to be taken in accordance with the agreement to close andeliminate the opportunity gap.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each collective bargaining agreement entered, reopened, and renewedafter the effective date of this section must specifically addressactions to be taken in accordance with the agreement to close andeliminate the opportunity gap.
